title: sphaeromeria cana
intro: Sphaeromeria cana, commonly known as Western Yarrow, is a flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of the common cold and flu. The health benefits of Western Yarrow include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful for wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of Western Yarrow include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing and calming the body.
